newsitem.title: USA: Maine Senate wants to invest in high-tech centers.
newsitem.headline: Maine Senate wants to invest in high-tech centers.

text.p: Maine Senate President Mark Lawrence has proposed a major investment in research programs throughout the state.
Calling his plan Jumpstart 2000, Lawrence said Maine needs to invest in its future by improving basic research centers and investing on a regular basis.
He wants $20 million a year for more research in bio- technology, aquaculture and other areas. Lawrence is also proposing a $17 million bond issue for new labs.
